Get StartedWhat’s included

Overview

What web development covers — and who it’s for.

DefinitionWeb development outsourcing is handing the design, build and upkeep of your websites and web applications to an external engineering team that works inside your tools and process.

Your website is your hardest-working salesperson and, too often, your most neglected system. Internal engineers are rightly focused on the core product, agencies disappear after launch, and freelancers rarely overlap with your working day. The result: a backlog of “quick fixes”, a stack nobody wants to touch, and a site that no longer matches the business you’ve become.

Akrostech gives you a standing web team without the hiring cycle. Designers, front-end and full-stack engineers join your Slack and stand-ups, work in your repositories, and deliver against a roadmap you control. New build, redesign or a careful migration off a legacy platform — we scope it, ship it in visible increments and stay on to maintain it.

It’s built for CTOs who need to protect core-product velocity, marketing leaders who need pages live this week, and operators running a revenue-critical site on a stack that has outgrown its original builder.

FAQ

Web Development, answered.

The questions decision-makers ask us before they sign. Something missing? Ask us directly.

Will we own the code and designs?

Yes. Everything we build lives in your repositories and design files from the first commit, and intellectual property is assigned to you under our agreement.

Can you work alongside our in-house engineers?

That is the most common setup. We follow your branching strategy, code review and deployment process, and join your stand-ups so the work feels like one team.

Which technologies do you work with?

Our core stack is React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript, plus WordPress, Webflow and Shopify. If you run something else, we will tell you honestly in the discovery call whether we are the right fit.

How do you price web development?

Either a dedicated monthly team for ongoing work, or a fixed, milestone-based price for a defined project. You get a written scope and estimate before any work starts — no surprise invoices.

Do you offer maintenance after launch?

Yes. Most clients keep us on a maintenance plan covering updates, security patches, monitoring, backups and a monthly allowance of improvements.
